orders.text:
Delay Condonation App. No. 1942 of 2016 
Bail Application No. 1943 of 2016 
In 
CRLA No. 377 of 2016
Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J. 
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. Pankaj Tangwan, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Mr. Raman Kumar Shah, Deputy Advocate 
General, with Ms. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand / respondent. 
There is delay of 187 days in filing the 
appeal. Objections have been filed. Heard the 
learned counsel for the parties. In the 
circumstances, we are of the view that the delay 
should be condoned. Accordingly, the delay is 
condoned. The Application will stand allowed. 
Admit. 
Learned Deputy Advocate General takes 
notice for the respondent. 
Call for the records. 
Objections, if any, to the Bail Application be 
filed within six weeks. 
 
 (Alok Singh, J.) (K.M. Joseph, C.J.) 
 01.05.2017 
G
